question: Which of the following states have the lowest female literacy rates as per 2011 census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan** has the **lowest female literacy rate** as per the **2011 census**.
 
• As per the 2011 Census, the female literacy rate in Rajasthan is approximately **52.66%**.
 
• Other states with low female literacy rates include **Uttar Pradesh** and **Jharkhand**, but Rajasthan ranks the lowest among them.
 
• 
 
• The low literacy rate is attributed to various socio-economic factors including traditional gender roles, lack of access to education, and early marriages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The literacy rate is a crucial indicator of social and economic development.
 
• Efforts have been made by both the central and state governments to improve female literacy through various schemes and programs.
 
• Programs such as **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao** and the **National Literacy Mission** aim to address the gender gap in literacy.
 
• Improving female literacy is essential for empowering women and fostering inclusive growth.
